intro.text: A member of the Ghostbloods in Elendel and Iyatil's brother, who wears a fierce Southern Scadrian mask he never takes off.

items.text: Ten hours after the Set's bomb went off, Dlavil was with Kelsier and other Ghostbloods in their Elendel safehouse. When Marasi Colms turned down Kelsier's offer to join them, Dlavil argued she knew too much and should be silenced, but TwinSoul and Kelsier disagreed, and Kelsier forbade him to act against anyone in Elendel without orders.
